entities.name: Yadava Prakaasa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yadava Prakasa was a Bṛhaddevatā Vedanta scholar and a contemporary of Vaishnava acharya Ramanuja. He was one of the teachers of Ramanuja during the latter's early years in Kanchi. It is said that Ramanuja joined Yadava Prakaasa's school while he was only sixteen years old.
